# Solar cold locker

A lockable insulated cabinet that sits behind the stall and keeps produce cold through the market day. A roof panel charges a small battery that runs a compressor, and a thermostat holds the inside near five degrees. The stall holder rents a locker by the day and loads it from the van.

Open questions: how many cloudy days the battery can carry, and whether a day rental price can cover the hardware.
